verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is mainly a law firm, but it ships interactive web tools such as the SCC Generator and German Term Sheet Generator (built on Contract Express), a HighQ deal room and AI-assisted review offerings, so asking about API parity with its UI is a fair question. The evidence describes only questionnaire-driven UIs and a DocuSign integration, with no public API documented. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404.
